_source: Web consensus (Yahoo/SI/PFN/RotoBaller/Seahawks.com, Aug 2026) + Joel Smyth guide dynasty ranks and Top-50 stats. Draft capital and roles as reported online; the guide's rank stays the value anchor.

rookies.name: Jeremiyah Love
rookies.capital: 1st round, 3rd overall - highest-drafted RB since Barkley 2018
rookies.college: Notre Dame: 6.9 YPC, 40 TD in 28 games, Heisman finalist; top-15 in yards after contact/att, breakaway rate and elusive rating two straight years; real receiver (10.9% target share)
rookies.situation: Bad offense and a cluttered backfield (Allgeier signed, McBride/Harrison eat targets) caps the rookie-year ceiling at strong RB2, but the talent is bell-cow grade
rookies.playstyle: explosive one-cut runner with pass-game chops - the profile guide stat #1 says goes RB1 by year 2

rookies.name: Carnell Tate
rookies.college: Ohio State: polished, pro-ready route runner
rookies.situation: Clearest volume path of the rookie WRs: pairs with Cam Ward as the day-one primary read, alpha-role trajectory
rookies.playstyle: high floor possession X with contested-catch craft

rookies.name: Jordyn Tyson
rookies.college: Arizona State: wins at every level, elite 50/50 ball skills
rookies.situation: Kellen Moore schemes touches for his best players and his offense was 8th in pass attempts/game; Olave draws the middle-field coverage, leaving Tyson the perimeter
rookies.playstyle: vertical/jump-ball winner in a high-pace scheme

rookies.name: Makai Lemon
rookies.capital: 1st round, 20th overall (slipped; many boards had him WR1)
rookies.situation: Crowded target tree (Smith, Goedert, Brown, Stowers) slows the ramp; talent says trust the ceiling over the early role
rookies.playstyle: manufactured-touch slot/perimeter hybrid - classic year-2 breakout shape

rookies.name: Jadarian Price
rookies.college: Notre Dame: explosive; PFF pass-block grade 38.5 was bottom-tier (guide stat #13 - rookie RBs always grade worst there)
rookies.situation: Significant early role while Charbonnet rehabs; committee risk, several outlets' rookie #1 for year one; eventual RB1 promise
rookies.playstyle: burst-and-breakaway back whose passing-down snaps must be earned

rookies.name: KC Concepcion
rookies.situation: Whoever starts at QB in Cleveland looks his way on shots; volatile but real big-play equity

rookies.name: Jonah Coleman
rookies.situation: Opens RB3 and buried early; injury-away stash whose path likely opens in the second half
rookies.playstyle: downhill grinder - handcuff-plus, not a week-1 play

rookies.name: Kenyon Sadiq
rookies.situation: Intermediate weapon for Geno Smith but battles Mason Taylor and had offseason hernia surgery - patience required
rookies.playstyle: move-TE athlete; dynasty-lean asset in year one

rookies.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
rookies.situation: Shanahan-tree offenses manufacture WR value; depth-chart path behind injury-prone starters is livelier than it looks

rookies.name: Eli Stowers
rookies.college: Vanderbilt: converted QB playing big-slot WR at TE
rookies.situation: Goedert heir apparent; if the starting role opens the upside is real, until then a stash
rookies.playstyle: big-slot receiving TE, minimal inline blocking

rookies.name: Fernando Mendoza
rookies.college: Indiana: Flacco-comp pocket arm with some mobility
rookies.situation: Sits behind Kirk Cousins; 2027 asset, not a redraft pick
rookies.playstyle: pocket passer - the guide's 31% hit-rate archetype (stat #7), not the 63% rushing kind

rookies.name: Denzel Boston
rookies.situation: Second Browns rookie WR; TD-dependent early
